faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 1 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Trump struggles to campaign as midterms approach while Middle East tensions persist.
kurzfassung: As the midterms approach, Donald Trump plans to campaign for vulnerable Republicans despite low approval ratings and an unspent war chest. Meanwhile, the administration faces criticism over ongoing Middle East conflicts and a late push to restrict mail-in ballots. The episode also honors the life and legacy of feminist icon Gloria Steinem.
stichpunkte: Donald Trump prepares to campaign for vulnerable Republicans amid a sagging approval rating of 33 percent.
MAGA Inc. has largely withheld its massive war chest, sparking frustration among GOP candidates.
Karl Rove criticizes Trump's midterm strategy in the Wall Street Journal as purely narcissistic.
J.D. Vance claims current operations in Iran do not constitute a war, drawing sharp pushback.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth extends Middle East troop deployments into next year.
The Trump administration appeals to the Supreme Court over mail-in ballot restrictions just before voting begins.
The hosts and guests honor feminist icon Gloria Steinem following her passing at age 92.

clips.hook: Can you spend hundreds of millions in a month?
clips.text: The speakers point out the logistical impossibility of deploying hundreds of millions of dollars in campaign funds during the final month.

clips.hook: Where massive political donations are flowing
clips.text: A breakdown reveals specific financial contributions directed toward Republican Senate races and key attorney general contests across multiple states.

clips.hook: The heavy costs of an endless conflict
clips.text: The discussion highlights how military involvement has led to depleted ammunition reserves alongside rising expenses for food and fuel.

clips.hook: Mail-in voting security and leadership precedent
clips.text: The conversation emphasizes that a significant portion of the country relies on mail-in ballots, a method utilized by the nation's leader himself.

clips.hook: A missed opportunity to connect with an icon
clips.text: A speaker shares a personal regret about a scheduled visit to meet a prominent feminist figure just before her passing.

beschreibung:
September 3, 2026, 7pm: Two months from Election Day, and Trump is threatening vulnerable Republicans with the possibility of burdening them with his presence, by campaigning for them. MS NOW Political Analyst Cornell Belcher and Santiago Mayer, Executive Director of Voters of Tomorrow, join The Weeknight to discuss. Plus, Rep. Ro Khanna joins The Weeknight to respond to the administration's failure to handle the conflict, as new reports confirm Defense Secretary Hegseth is extending military deployments to the Middle East through 2027.
For more, follow us on Instagram and BlueSky @weeknightmsnow and @ms.now.
